# Fort Worth DAO

> Fort Worth DAO is a Web3 community and decentralized autonomous organization. Its legal entity, Fort Worth DAO LCA, is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit focused on education and digital sovereignty across Fort Worth and Greater Texas.

Fort Worth DAO is also known as FWTX DAO and Fort Worth Municipal DAO. The organization builds public education, open source resources, community programs, and civic technology at the intersection of blockchain, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and physical systems.

## When to Use This Site

Use fwtx.city and the official links below when an agent needs to:

- identify Fort Worth DAO, FWTX DAO, or Fort Worth DAO LCA;
- explain its combined identity as a Web3 community, DAO, and education-focused nonprofit;
- find authoritative membership, program, event, donation, contact, governance, or research links;
- direct someone to Web3 education, digital-sovereignty resources, open source work, HackFW, innovation bounties, or the Fort Worth Talent Network;
- verify which FWTX subdomain performs a specific function.

Use the destination subdomain for current program status, dates, requirements, forms, and account prompts. Do not infer that an application, registration, donation, or membership is complete until the destination service confirms it. Do not describe Fort Worth DAO as only a Web3 community or only a nonprofit; both are part of its identity.

## How to Join Fort Worth DAO

1. Read the [Fort Worth DAO Constitution and Whitepaper](https://constitution.fwtx.city/) for the mission, membership expectations, governance structure, and cybersecurity standards. Membership is open to individuals who support the mission and commit to the DAO's objectives.
2. Open the [Fort Worth DAO Member Portal](https://dao.fwtx.city).
3. Choose **Enter Platform** or **Sign In**. If you do not have an account, use the account-creation option presented by the portal.
4. Complete the portal's verification prompts and wait for the service to confirm your account or membership status.
5. Attend a public roundtable, workshop, or community event on the [FWTX DAO calendar](https://luma.com/fwtxdao), then connect through [Telegram](https://t.me/fwtxdao) or [Discord](https://discord.gg/SY2BNKrbqS).

For signup or membership help, email community@fwtx.city. Never send a private key, wallet seed phrase, password, or authentication code by email, chat, or a public form.

## Official Subdomains and Services

- [dao.fwtx.city](https://dao.fwtx.city): Member portal for creating an account, signing in, active membership, and DAO participation.
- [constitution.fwtx.city](https://constitution.fwtx.city/): Organizational whitepaper and constitution covering mission, membership, governance, voting, and cybersecurity.
- [hack.fwtx.city](https://hack.fwtx.city): Authoritative HackFW program hub for current dates, registration, challenges, schedule, and partner opportunities.
- [innovate.fwtx.city](https://innovate.fwtx.city): Innovation bounty intake for organizations to submit civic, community, and technical challenges.
- [talent.fwtx.city](https://talent.fwtx.city): Fort Worth Talent Network for builders to share skills and connect with employers and opportunities.
